recent_articles.title: Dubai-based Indian man, wife killed in Kerala road crash; daughter survives after last-minute car switch - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A tragic road accident in Kerala claimed the lives of a Dubai-based Indian man, his wife, and his aunt. **Shafid Ebrahim** (40), an interior designer working in Dubai, was driving with his family when their car collided with a lorry parked on the roadside.
